_comment: Per-country <title>/<meta description> for /country/<slug>. Keys in overrides are country slugs; missing fields fall back to the defaults ({name} = country name). Used by CountryPage.tsx (client) and scripts/prerender-country-meta.mjs (static HTML for crawlers). Plain text only; HTML escaping happens at render time.

defaults.title: {name} Swear Words — 10 Phrases with Pronunciation | How Every Country Swears
defaults.description: {name} swear words and insults with pronunciation, meanings, risk ratings and cultural context. A recognition guide from How Every Country Swears.

samoa.title: Samoan Swear Words & Insults: Meaning, Risk & Respect
samoa.description: What Samoan insults actually mean, how risky they are, and why church, family and fa'aSamoa respect change the weight. Recognition guide, not a script.

nepal.title: Nepali Swear Words & Insults: Meaning, Risk & Context
nepal.description: What Nepali insults mean, how hard they land, and why caste, family honor and respect for elders change the weight. Recognition guide, not a script.

sri-lanka.title: Sri Lankan Swear Words: Sinhala & Tamil Insults Explained
sri-lanka.description: Sri Lanka swears in Sinhala and Tamil. See meanings, risk ratings and the family and respect context that sets the weight. Recognition, not permission.
